The following public key algorithms are available :

v1Price.description:
Price of a single billable resource. For block and object storage,
the price applies per GiB; for all other categories it applies per
resource.

maxSyncReplicas.description: Maximum number of synchronous replicas (must be >= min_sync_replicas)

resolved.description:
Mapping from API GPU name to the fully qualified K8s resource name
("nvidia.com/<ResourceName>"). One entry per unique input name.

secrets.description: New S3 credentials. Only returned once, store securely.

accessKeyId.description: S3 access key ID. Only returned once on creation, store securely.

accessSecretKey.description: S3 secret access key. Only returned once on creation, store securely.

replicas.description: Number of replicas for this shard

size.description: Storage capacity in GB for this shard

config.description: Sharding configuration (required when enabled is true)

replication.description:
Grant replication privileges.

Allows the user to:
- Connect in replication mode
- Use streaming replication functions
- Receive WAL for physical or logical replication

Required for backup tools and read replicas.

role.description:
Role for this vhost.

Possible values:
- 'admin': full access (configure/write/read on all resources)
- 'readonly': read-only access
- '' (empty): no role on this vhost

subnets.description:
Subnet names within this VPC to connect to.
Each subnet adds secondary network interfaces to the VM.

configOverride.description:
Helm values override (object)
See https://github.com/vmware-tanzu/helm-charts/tree/main/charts/velero for available options

admin.description: List of users with admin role on this vhost

readonly.description: List of users with readonly role on this vhost

ApiKey.description: Project api-key (sk_hk_<keyId>_<secret>) for machine clients. Callable operations are those of the public document.
ApiKey.name: X-Hikube-Api-Key
